info.name: Business Central Administration Center Accounts Environments API

description.content:
REST API for programmatic administration of Dynamics 365 Business Central environments. Enables querying and managing production and sandbox environments, setting up administrative notifications, viewing tenant telemetry, managing apps, scheduling updates, and performing environment operations such as copy, rename, restore, and delete.
